name: Mortar Shells
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: Four mortar tubes are constantly being auto-loaded by robotic arms before swiveling to launch projectiles onto the nearby battlefield.
disable: Warfare Lore|dc:16 to engage the mortar safety switches, DC 18 Thievery to jam the auto-loading mechanisms so no more ammunition can be cycled, or DC 20 Athletics to push the tubes out of alignment such that the projectiles no longer threaten the battlefield
reset: The hazard resets automatically. Any time a PC leaves the trenches, they're targeted by Exploding Ordinance until the mortar shells hazard is disabled.

defensiveAbilities.name: Exploding Ordinance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature fails its check to disable the mortar shells hazard

Effect A mortar shell explodes, dealing 2d10 Fire Damage damage in a 10ft Type:burst centered on a corner of the triggering creature's square with a Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save.
